jobs.label: SAM interception explosion
jobs.description: A distinctive substantial aerial missile hit: keys1-2 hot white/yellow flash;3-5 jagged orange fire bloom with few silver fragments;6-8 brighter amber flame core inside billowing charcoal-gray smoke;9-12 cooler expanding dark slate puff;13-15 thin pale fading smoke. Peak diameter260px. No dirt or ground crater, no target plane, no nuclear mushroom, no giant shockwave. Sixteen stages including final empty.
jobs.prompt: Use case: image-edit. Correct this16-frame4x4 transparent explosion atlas. It must have FOUR rows and FOUR equal314x314 cells on1254x1254 canvas. Each effect is independently centered inside its cell; reduce every effect and ALL glow/ring/wisp edges until TOTAL diameter is at most210px with50px CLEAR fully transparent cell margin. Do NOT let any glow or smoke touch a border or adjoining cell. Preserve distinct progressive flash-fire-smoke stages, but first key is smallflash, NOT full blast. Paint neutral gray/white smoke edges with no blue/purple halo. Last key16 bottom-right is COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent, remove even the tiny remaining smoke speck. All15nonempty cells fully contained. Strict vertical overhead, no ground or objects. No backdrop or grid lines. This remains the SAM interception explosion animation. Use15progressive poses plus empty final, readable luminous sparks and soft alpha smoke.
